turns.q: I don't want to overpay while I'm still learning, what's a good starter pick?
turns.replyTail:
the easiest low-risk start, I would begin with one pair in a classic straight fit or a relaxed fit rather than buying several styles at once. Those are usually the simplest to wear and compare while you figure out what you like.

If you want to keep costs down, starting with a single pair and using the fit quiz first is probably the best move: https://www.kutfromthekloth.com/pages/fit-quiz

If the fit is not right, you can start a return here: https://kutfromthekloth.loopreturns.com/#/
